gaps.note: the sheet's figure draws five top fingers, a flange with five tabs and windows in the plate, and its table gives A, B and C only. The finger width, the tab size and the window sizes are read off the figure against B and A. The top view's tip radius (6 mm) and folded rim (the sheet's 1.9 mm) are stand-ins for the rounded tip and folded edge the figure shows, and the fold's depth is not drawn. The finger, tab and flange are drawn in mid steel tones so they read against the black plate; the sheet states none.

the sheet's figure shows a rolled top edge on the cover, two slot marks near the ends and the name plate at the middle. The face draws a 6 mm roll, a 14 by 4 mm slot 12 mm in from each end and the plate's 45 by 25 mm box blank; the roll's width and the slot's size and place are stand-ins.
the sheet states no count of cables, nor a basis for one; it says only that the fingers align with the patch panel's adaptors.
gaps.wanted: a maker's figure with its basis
`attrs.physical.weight-kg` (profile `passive` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - material, gauge and finish are the sheet's specification table; the cover, the pass-through holes and the corresponding vertical manager are its characteristics table; the UPC is its ordering table.

cable-capacity.note: datasheet - the sheet states no cable capacity, so none is stated here and none is estimated.

chassis.note: datasheet - 482.6 x 88.9 x 76.2. Width is B, 19 in; height is A, 3.5 in, which the figure marks along the plate's end; ru is the sheet's 2 RU; depth is C, 3 in, the sheet's own "Depth 3 in", the whole projection from the back of the plate to the front of the cover.

ears.note: datasheet - `positions` states where the part bolts, for the Rack Builder. The plate is the part's own ears and stands at the back of the part, so the rail plane is the back of the plate and the whole depth, C, 76.2, stands in front of it: `at` is 76.2. The sheet's accessories list a replacement cover and hook-and-loop ties and no rail kit, so `kits` is not stated.

front.note: estimated - the front: the plate with its four windows, the flange along its foot, the five fingers along its top, the five tabs and the cover. The figure has no scale, so the finger pitch and the window sizes are read against B (see the plate's `windows`): five fingers 104 mm apart, symmetric about the middle, one over the web between each pair of windows and one at each end. The cover is drawn fitted; the `cover-off` configuration leaves it off and shows the fingers and tabs.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - nothing of the part stands behind the rail; it reaches 76.2 in front of it, so the rack unit's rear face is free.

guides.note: estimated - the `duct` guide is the channel between the finger row and the flange, the width of the part, its run along the rack: 85.1 mm high, from under the fingers to over the flange. `finger-pitch` is the 104 mm between fingers read on the figure and `finger-gap` the 80 mm between two, the pitch less the finger's 24.

left.note: estimated - an elevation, rear on the left: the plate's edge, a finger along the top, the flange along the foot and a tab standing up at the front of it. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN SPEC SHEET. Hubbell publishes one PDF per catalogue number, PREMISE_HS23C_spec.pdf on hubbellcdn.com (sha256 below): a features list, an ordering table, specifications, characteristics, accessories and a dimensions table, A 2 RU, 3.5 in (89), B 19 in (483), C 3 in (76), beside one isometric figure that marks A, B and C. The sheet lists no "Customer Use Drawing" (only "Customer Drawings" and "eCatalog", whose host, ecatalog.hubbell-premise.com, does not resolve, checked 2026-10-18), so no dimensioned drawing was read: the figure is a line drawing without a scale, and everything read off it is `estimated`, with how.

rear.note: estimated - the back of the plate: the four windows and the plate round them. The figure draws a hole in each ear, not drawn here (see the plate's `mounting-holes`).

thickness.note: datasheet - "Gauge 14", 0.0747 in, 1.9 mm by the standard sheet gauge.

top.note: estimated - an elevation, rear at y=0: the plate's edge and the five fingers lying forward from it. The cover's edge is not drawn: the configuration with it off draws the same plan.
